name: Genki Robotics humanoid
summary: A full-size bipedal humanoid with five-fingered hands from Andy Rubin's Tokyo startup, first shown in November 2026; the first product model is being built and no specifications or price are published.

germany.statusNote: Shown publicly for the first time on 12 November 2026 in Tokyo; the company says it is now turning the robot into a product. No price, delivery date or European sales route.

specs.label: Form
specs.quote: The robot shown at the Kantei is a full-size biped with a grey and white shell, a dark faceplate for a head, green accents on its forearms and black five-fingered hands with green fingertips.

specs.label: In-house hardware
specs.quote: Genki designs its own actuators and cameras

specs.label: Target abilities
specs.value: walking on flat ground and stairs, patrolling, carrying objects
specs.quote: walking on flat ground and stairs, patrolling and carrying objects

notes: Footage shown with the robot had it walking in an empty room, in an office and on grass, and doing tabletop work.
Stairs and carrying are stated goals, so they are left unconfirmed.
Genki plans an open software platform with a marketplace for robot behaviours.

evidence.task: Walking indoors and on grass and doing tabletop work (company footage)
evidence.note: Shown on a screen at the Prime Minister's Office; the robot itself stood on a support stand.

sources.title: Andy Rubin's Genki Robotics Shows Its Humanoid to Japan's Prime Minister

openQuestions: Product name, specifications, price and launch markets are not published; the company website has no images or specs yet.
When the first product model will ship.
